name: Christmas Dreams
source:
A Christmas Carol inspired tale: 
Take a look inside Mary's mind, an avid lucid dreamer, and help her overcome grief.

Inspired by how absolutly Meta and absurd Lucid Dreaming can become. 

[From [url=https://alejandroaceytunogonzalez.itch.io/christmas-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个受圣诞颂歌启发的故事：
看看玛丽这个热心的清醒梦者的内心，帮助她克服悲伤。

灵感来自绝对的元和荒谬的清醒梦。

[来自[url=https://alejandroaceytunogonzalez.itch.io/christmas-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
